title: Finding Resources in MapleStory Worlds
author: MapleStory Worlds Creator Center
summary: The official Creator Center lesson explains how to locate Maker resources by category, text, image, and RUID while organizing personal resources and favorites.

sections.title: Resource discovery
items: Use Resource Storage categories, text search, or image search.
Copy the selected RUID for use in Maker.
Organize My Resources and Favorites without duplicating an RUID across folders.

notes: Structured summary verified against the official Creator Center lesson on 2026-07-27.
steps: Open Resource Storage from the Maker panels.
Choose My Resources, MSW Resources, or Favorites.
Search by category, text, or image.
Copy the selected resource RUID and use it in the project.
